tei:div.tei:p: 321) ༄༅/ gsang sngags rnying lugs ltar gyi cha gsum gtor chog rgyas pa bzhugs so/ 322) dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/

mdo rgyud thun mong nas gsungs pa'i cha gsum gtor ma ji ltar bya ba'i lam rim ni/ spyir gsang sngags gsar snying thun mong ltar na rnal 'byor yo ga'i rgyud sde dag las gsungs pa ding sang chos rgyud phal mo ches phyag len la mdzad bzhin pa yin mod kyi/ 'dir gsang sngags kyi lugs la grags pa'i 'dus pa mdo'i dkyil chog dang*/ zhi khro bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa sogs las ji ltar gsungs bzhin bkod par bya ba la/ de yang chu gtor sogs kyi skabs dang 'brel ba'i tshe ni gtor rdzas bshams bkod sogs skabs de dang mthun par khyer bde tsam las 'os med rung*/ gang zhig nad pa sogs kyi don 323) nam/ de las gzhan yang rung bar cha gsum ched gtad du gtong ba la ni/ stegs gtsang ma'i khar me tog sil ma bkram la/ rin chen gyi snod bzang po gsum la gtor ma zlum po pad 'dab sbyar ba gsum gyi dbang po phyogs skyong rgyal chen sogs kyi de la dkar gsum mngar gsum zas sna bzang po sogs gtso cher blugs/ gnyis pa bde brgyad sogs rigs drug gi gtor ma de la cha shang sogs bza btung shas che ba dang/ gsum pa lan chags bgegs rigs kyi gtor ma ni nad pa'i lus bsgres pa'i zan gyi chang bu sogs kyang blug tu rung la gzhan yang 'bru chen dang la phug bra khur snum sngo tshod sogs zas skom bzang ngan sna tshogs pa spungs pa dang*/ gtor ma gsum kar 'bru sman shing tog zas sna sogs ji ltar sna 'dzom 324) zhing tshang ba legs la/ rin chen mchod rdar sogs yod na'ang brdar te/ mdor na 'dod yon rgya gang cher bsags pa blug nas bshams pa dang lhan cig phyi mchod sna snga tshang ba yang bsham la bkod pas mdzes par bya'o/ cho ga dngos la/ chu gtor dang 'brel ba na de ka'i bdag bskyed spyan ras gzigs sngon du yod pas 'thus shing*/ gsum pa bgegs gtor skabs su spyan ras gzigs nyid rta mgrin du gnas bsgyur bar bya ba yin la/

chu gtor gyi zhor ma yin pa cha gsum zur du byed pa yin na/ bdag bskyed rdor sems bskyed par gsungs pas na/ skyabs sems yan lag bdun pa spyi mthun sngon du btang la/ oṃswa bha wa shūdhaḥsarba dharmā swa bha shūdho3 haṃ/ bdag gzhan snang srid 'khor 'das gyi dngos 'dzin bag chags thams cad mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las pad dkar zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du rang rig yi ge hūm̐ dkar po'i rnam par gsal ba las 'od 'phros/ rgyal ba mchod/ sems can gyi don byas 325)'od zer tshul 'dus hūm̐ la thim/ yongs su gyur pa la rang nyid rigs dang dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi khyab bdag dpal rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog zla ba'i 'od mdangs ltar dkar zhing gsal 'tsher zhi 'dzum can/ phyag g.yas gser gyi rdo rje thugs kar bstod de 'dzin cing g.yon pas dngul gyi dril bu dkur bsten pa/ dar gyi na bza' dang rin po che'i rgyan cha lugs sna tshogs pas mdzes shing brjid pa/ 'od lnga'i klong na rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs par gsal ba'i spyi bor oṃ mgrin pa āḥ thugs dkar hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas ma lus dpal rdo rje sems dpa'i rnam par byon nas bdag dang dbyer med du thim par gyur/ hūm̐/ ye shes phung po mkha' 'dra ba'i/ sku gsung thugs kyi bdag nyid che// sprul pa kun gyi 'byung gnas gtso// rdo rje sems dpa' gshegs su 326) gsol/ badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ slar yang gnas gsum 'bru gsum las 'od 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor bcas spyan drangs pa rnams kyi bdud rtsi'i bum pas dbang bskur nas bum pa'i chu tshangs bug du babs pas sku gang dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pas rigs lngas dbu brgyan par gyur/ rang gi gnas gsum gyi 'od zer mchod rdzas rnams la phog pa tsam gyis/ ma dag 'bags rtsog gi dri ma thams cad dang bral te/

kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin bla na med pa nam mkha' rab 'byams kyi mthar khyab cing rgyun mi chad pa'i rgyal ba kun gyi spyod yul rmad du byung ba'i rang bzhin du gyur/ oṃ/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho ye shes kyis// srid pa rgya mtsho mtha' yas kun// spyod pa rgya mtsho rmad byung bas// kun bzang mchod sprin mchog tu rol/ 327)oṃ badzra sa twa sa pa ri wa ra arghaṃ/ pā dyaṃ/ puṣpe/ dhu pe/ a lo ke/ gandhe/ nai wi dya/ shasda pra tī tstsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ya āḥhūm̐/ hūm̐/ rnam dag sgrib pa srid gsum skyon bral zhing*// ston ka'i zla gsal dri med zhal mnga' ba// bcom ldan bde gshegs rdo rje dkyil 'khor gtso// khyab bdag rdo rje sems la phyag 'tshal bstod// thugs kar zla ba nya gang ba'i gdad steng du hūm̐ yig dkar po'i mtha' skor du sngags kyis bskor ba las 'od zer grangs med 'phros pas 'gro ba mtha' dag gi sdig sgrib nyon mongs sdug bsngal zhi bar gyur/ oṃ badzra satwa hūm̐/ zhes long khyab dang bstun nas ci nus bzlas pa'i mthar/ badzra sarawa sa pa ri wa ra badzra arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod cing*/ mi rtog mnyam pa'i lha khyod rtag tu bdag la ni// thugs rje'i 328)spyan gyis gzigs shing rtag tu 'gro ba'i dpal// byang chub mchog gi spyod pa sgrub par dam bcas pa'i// bdag gi re ba'i 'bras bu 'di yang mchis par mdzod/ de ltar 'di yan chad ni bdag nus ldan du sgrub pa'i cho ga ste/ ci nas kyang med du mi rung zhing/ gal te chu gtor gyi bdag bskyed dang 'brel ba yin na 'di med kyang chog go de na cha gsum gtor ma byin rlabs bya ste/ bsang chu gtsang ma 'thor la/ oṃ badzra sakṣa hūm̐/ oṃ sba bha ba shūdhaḥ sarba dharmaḥ swa bhā wa shūdho3 haṃ/ gtor ma'i nyes sgrib mtha' dag sbyangs zhing gdod nas rnam par dag pa'i ngo bor lhun gyis grub par gyur/

na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyo bi shwa mu khe bhyaḥ sarba tha khaṃ utga re spha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swā hūḥ gtor rdzas 'dod pa'i yon tan zad med du 'phel bar gyur/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta kuṇd+ra li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭaḥ 329) mgron so so'i yid la ji ltar 'dod pa'i dngos por gyur/ na ma sarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te/ oṃ sambha ra sambha ra hūm̐/ mgron rigs mchog dman bar ma kun gyis pham rgyal thabs rtsod med par thob cing tshim par gyur/ sarba ka ri sarba siddhi hūm̐/ mgron thams cad dgyes pas bdag gis ji ltar bsgo ba'i bka' nyan cing gsung sgrub par gyur/ bdag gi bsam pa'i stobs dang ni/ zhes sogs nas/ thogs pa med pa 'byung gyur cig de nas dang por mgon po yon tan gyi mgron du gyur pa gtsang ma ris kyi dpal mgon bdun cu sogs spyan drangs pa ni/ oṃ badzra sa twa hūm̐/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ bdag nyid rdor sems kyi thugs srog hūm̐ las byams dang snying rje dga' ba btang snyoms kyi 'od zer las sprul pa'i lha mo lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril bu'i phyag rgya can 330) grangs med pa 'phros te yon tan gyi mgron rnams spyan drangs par gyur/ phyogs skyong 'jig rten skyong ba dbang dang ldan// thugs rje thabs mkhas thugs dam dkyel po che// lha dang drang srong gshin rje srin po klu// rlung lha gnod sbyin bgegs gza' rgyu skar sa// de dag so so'i dbang po'i skur ston pa// phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten skyong ba bzhugs so 'tshal// bstan pa rgyas pa'i slad du spyan 'dren na// 'gro ba'i don phyir mchod kyi gshegs su gsol// tshangs pa dang ni brgya byin dang*// rgyal chen bzhi dang phyogs skyong bcu// phyi yi mgon po thugs dam can// dam tshig dbang gis spyan 'dren gyi// mchod phyir gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ oṃ da sha di ka lo ka pa la a ti pa ha ye/

sa pa ri wa ra sa ma dzaḥ hūm̐/ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis// tshur gshegs phyogs skyong 331)mgon po rnams// mchod yon bzhes nas 'di nyid du// bzhugs shing bdag la dgyes par mdzod// ga ga na sa ma ya hūm̐/ zhes brjod pas/ mdun du rin po che'i gzhal med khang sgo kyang rta bab med pa yangs shing rgya che bar padma'i gdan la bzhugs par bsam nas/ hūm̐/ dag cing gtsang mar sbyar ba yi// mchod yon me tog spos rab dang*// mar me zhal zas gtor ma dri// rol mo bstod dbyangs bcas pa 'di// 'jig rten skyong ba'i tshogs la 'bul// thugs rjes brtse bar dgongs nas kyang*// bstan pa bsrung phyir bzhes su gsol/ oṃ da sha di ka lo ka pa la sa pa ri wa ra gṛ hne dam/ arghaṃ swa hā/ puṣpe swa hā/ zhes sogs kyi mthar/ shapda swā hā/ zhes mchod nas/ bstod pa ni/ dbang po rdo rje 'chang ba'i lha// lha yi rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /shar phyogs 332) dri za'i tshogs bcas la// mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal// me ste bsreg bya za ba'i lha// drang srong rgyal po don gyi bdag /shar lho me lha'i tshogs bcas la// mchod cing bstod do phyag kyang 'tshal// gshin rje be con 'chang ba'i lha// ma mo'i rgyal po don gyi bdag /lho phyogs gshin rje'i tshogs bcas la// mchod cing bstod do phyag kyang 'tshal// bden dang bral ba legs ldan lha// srin po'i rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /lho nub srin po'i tshogs bcas la// mchod cing bstod do phyag kyang 'tshal// zhugs pa thogs pa chu yi lha// klu yi rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /nub phyogs chu lha'i tshogs bcas la// mchod cing bstod do phyag kyang 'tshal// rlung ste srog kyang 'dzin pa'i lha// rig 'dzin rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /nub byang rlung lha'i tshogs bcas la// mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal// gnod sbyin lag na dbyug to thogs// nor srung rgyal po gdon gyi bdag

byang phyogs gnod 333)sbyin tshogs bcas la// mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal// dbang dang ldan pa 'dren pa'i lha// 'byung po rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /byang shar dbang ldan tshogs bcas la// mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal// steng gi tshangs pa chen po dang*// nyi ma zla ba gza' chen po// gza' dang rgyu skar tshogs bcas la// mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal// 'og gi klu ste sa yi lha// sa 'dzin lag pa chen po dang*// dam tshig shes pa'i tshogs bcas la// mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal// mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal// zab cing rgya che gzigs pa po// yul 'khor srung dang 'phags skyes po// spyan mi bzang dang rnam thos sras// rgyal chen rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod/ oṃ ind+ra ye swā hā/ agni ye swā hā/ ya ma ye swā hā/ nai ri tya swā hā wa ru ṇa ye swā hā/ ba ya be swā hā/ ku we ra ye swā hā/ i sha na ye swā hā/ bra hma ṇi swā ha/ 334)surya tsand+ra ye swā hā/ pra sthi bhyaḥswā hā/ na ga bhye swā hā/ oṃ dhri ṭa raṣṭa ye swā hā/ oṃ bai ru dha kā ye swā hā/ oṃ bai ru pakṣa ye swā hā/ oṃ bai shra ma ṇa swā hā/ de nas gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ na mo/ chos rnams rag bzhin rnam dag cing*/ /rgyal ba sras bcas thugs rje dang*// sngags dang phyag rgya'i nus pa dang*// ting 'dzin smon lam mthu dang las// dri ro bcung ldan lha yi zas// gnas gos bgo ba rgyan la sogs// 'dod pa'i yon tan kun ldan zhing*/ dbang po'i yul kun tshim byed pa// yid bzhin nor bu dpag bsam shing*// khrus kyi rdzing bu skyed tshal rta// bum pa bzang po la sogs pa// kun bzang rnam 'phrul mchod sprin tshogs// 'di 335)nas 'khor ba ji srid bar// bsam gyi mi khyab 'byung gyur cig /de ltar 'bul ba'i mgron dang yul// tshangs pa brgya byin rgyal chen bzhi// phyogs skyong lha klu gza' skar sogs// thub pa'i bstan dang 'khor skyong ba'i// dam tshig ldan pa'i tshogs la 'bul// de dag so sor chos dang nor// 'jig rten 'das dang ma 'das kyi// 'dod yon phun tshogs bsam mi khyab// khyed la 'byung zhing gnas gyur cig

/shar phyogs rdo rje can gyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas// gtor ma 'bul ba 'di dag bzhes su gsol// me dang gshin rje bden bral srin po'i bdag /chu bdag rlung bdag nor gyi bdag po dang*// dbang ldan lha ste 'byung po'i bdag po dang*// steng gi nyi zla tshangs pa chen po dang*// lha rnams kun dang gang dag sa steng klu// ri yi 336)lha dang gnod sbyin tshogs bcas la// 'dod yon rmad byung gtor ma 'bul ba rnams// rab tu dgyes pa yid kyis bzhes nas kyang*// rang rang phyogs su legs par rab bzhugs te// rang gi bud med mdza' bshes gnyen 'dun dang*// nang mi dmag dang dpung bcas lhan cig tu// me tog dri dang byug pa gtor mar bcas// 'di rnams gsol zhing legs par bsnams nas kyang*// bdag gi las kyi 'bras bu mchis par mdzod// rtag tu skye med chos ni de bzhin gshegs// sems can thams cad bde bar gshegs dang mtshungs// byis pa'i blo can mtshan mar 'dzin pa dag /'jig rten dag dang med pa'i chos la spyod// ngag rnams bsrung zhing yid kyis rab bsdam ste// lus kyi mi dge ba dag mi byed cing*// las lam gsum po 'di dag rab blangs na// drang srong gsungs pa'i lam ni thob par 'gyur/ 337) phrin las bcol ba ni/ sngon tshe rgyal ba'i spyan snga ru// bstan pa bsrung zhing 'khor rnams bzhi// rjes 'jug skyes bu dam ldan rnams// bsrung zhing skyob par zhal bzhes pa'i// srog snying bden tshig phul ba bzhin// bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag la// skyobs pa'i skal yul dman na yang*// srung ma khyed cag thugs rje yis// 'gal rkyen nad gnod bar chad rigs// thams cad myur du zhi bar mdzod// tshe dbang dpal dang longs spyod rnams// phun tshogs rgyas dang 'phel bar mdzod// ye shes dang ni 'jig rten gyi// dngos kun dbang du 'du bar mdzod// lan chags gnod 'tshe'i bsam sbyor ngan// ma lus rdul du rlag par mdzod// khyed kyi thugs dam ma g.yel bar// bstan pa bsrung zhing bdag cag gi

/skyon zhi yon tan kun 'phel nas// bsam pa chos mthun 'grub par mdzod// khyod gyi thugs dang 'gal 338)ba'i las// bdag sogs rmongs shing 'khrul pa'i rgyus// mi dge spyod dang mchod pa dman// rgyu ngan phud nyams dri mas dgos// bying rgod ma dag 'gal 'khrul sogs// nyams chags ci bsags mthol zhing bshags// bzod bzhes tshangs pa stsol ba dang*// las kyi dngos grub ma lus stsol/ oṃ pra ti tsittā ri ma hā sa ma ya ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭaḥ badzra mum̐/ ya hi gatstsha/ mgon po yon tan gyi mgron rnams rang gnas su gshegs par gyur/ zhes pas gtor ma dang po gshegs so/ gtor ma bar pa ni rigs drug snying rje'i mgron du gtogs pa'i stong gsum gyi mi dang mi ma yin pa'i rigs mtha' dag la bsngo ba yin te/ byin rlabs gong gi de ka'i 'thus par bya ba'am/ spro na 'dir yang snga ma ltar lan cig byas la mgron spyan drangs ba ni/ yang bdag nyid rdo rje sems dpa'i thugs srog hūm̐ las byang chub sems kyi 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu grangs med 339) 'phros pas stong gsum 'jig rten khams kyi lha klu sde brgyad mi dang mi min 'byung po mthu bo che rigs drug thams cad skad cig gis bkag nas 'dus par gyur/ lha dang klu dang gnod sbyin lto 'phye grul// nam mkha' lding dang 'dab bzang lus srul po/ dri za srin po gdon gyi rigs rnams dang*// gang dag sa la gnas pa'i rdzu 'phrul can// bu mad g.yog 'khor tshogs dang bcas rnams la// bdag gi pus mo sa la btsug nas ni// thal mo sbyar bas khyod la gsol 'debs na// gsan nas phan gdags slad du 'dir gshegs shig /srid pa'i rtse nas mnar med yan chad kyi// skye ba rnam bzhis bsdus pa'i sems can rnams// gtan pa med pa'i mchod sbyin gnas 'di ru// dga' dang gus pa'i yid kyis 'du bar gyis/ oṃ dāe ba/ na ga yakṣa/ ghandharbha/ a su ra/ ga ru ḍa/

kinna ra/ ma ho ra ga ma nuṣa dya/ sarba shu ta/ pre ta/ a nṛ su tri pre du dzaḥ sa pa ri 340)wa ra sa mā dzaḥ mchog dman bar ma'i mgron kun la/ spos dang me tog mar me dri/ zhal zas gtor ma bstod dbyangs bcas/ bdag gi phul zhing bsngos pa yis/ dgyes shing byams pa'i sems ldan te/ so so'i sdug bsngal kun bral shog sarba bhu ta/ ka ma gu ṇa sarba pū dza bha lingta gh-i hne daṃ pra ti swā hāḥ 'byung po gang dag ri rab steng gnas dang// dga' ba'i tshal dang lha yi gnas rnams dang*// shar nub ri dang nyi zla'i khyim rnams dang*// ri bo kun la gang dag gnas pa dang*/ 341) /rin chen gling na lhag par gang gnas dang*// chu bo kun dang chu yi mdo rnams dang*// mtsho dang rdzing bu ldeng ka chu ngogs dang*// g.ya' chu sil ma can la gang gnas dang*// grong dang phyugs lhas grong khyer stong pa dang*// khang stong dag dang lha yi khang pa dang*// gtsug lhag khang dang mchod rten gnas rnams dang*// dka' thub gnas dang glang chen bres dang ni// rgyal po'i dkor khang dag na gang gnas dang*// lam srang sum mdo dang ni bzhi mdo dang*// gang dag lam po che dang shing gcig drung*// dur khrod chen po nags tshal chen po dang*// seng ge dred dang gcan zan gnas rnams dang*// 'brog chen 'jigs su rung bar gang gnas dang*// gang dag gling mchog dag na gnas pa dang*// lhun po dur khrod dag la gnas pa rnams// rab tu dgyes shing mgu bar gyur nas su/ 342) /'phreng ba me tog dri dang byug pa dang*// bstod dang gtor mar bcas pa gus 'bul na// 'di dag bzhes te btung shing bsnams nas su// bdag gi las kyi 'bras bu mchis par mdzod// srid rtse gnar med yan chad kyi/ rgyud drug skye bzhi 'gro drug gi// sems can ma lus thams cad dang*// khyad par grogs byed lha mgon rigs// de dag so so'i spyod yul du// gang mos cis 'dul chos dang nor// 'das dang ma 'das bde ba kun// so so'i yid dang tshul mthun par// nam mkha' ji srid mthar thug bar// skal bar 'byung zhing thob gyur cig

/de dag thams cad ma lus kyi// sdig bral sgrib byang tshogs rdzogs te// thar pa zab cing rgya che'i chos// bla med sgrub pa'i rgyu gyur cig /de yi dge bas bdag sogs kyi// las dbang mi dang mi min gyi// gnod 'tshe 343)nad dang sdug bsngal dang*// bkra mi shis dang rmi lam ngan// rbod gtong nyes skyon zhi gyur cig /tshe ring nad med mthu dang ni// dpal dang gzi brjid dngos grub tshogs// 'jig rten pa dang 'das rnams kyi// legs pa'i yon tan 'phel gyuta cig /mi dang mi min gang yang rung*// tshe srog mthu byin longs spyod dang*// dpal dang gzi brjid 'phrog byed sogs// bar chad ma lus sol gyur cig /sems can myal ba'i sdug bsngal dang*// yi dwags bkres shing skom pa dang*// dud 'gro bkol spyod brdeg 'tshog sogs// sdug bsngal ma lus zhi gyur cig /sems can thams cad bde ldan zhing*// sdug bsngal kun las grol nas ni// de bzhin gshegs pas sngags mdzad pa'i// byang chub dam pa thob gyur cig /ji ltar 'jig rten las dang nyon mongs rgyur bcas byed 344) rgyur ldan gyur pa// las dang nyon mongs pa dang zlog rgyu de yang 'dren pas rab tu gsungs// gang na 'chi 'pho skye dang rgas dang rgud pa'i sdug bsngal mi gnas pa// thar pa'i mchog ste smra ba'i khyu mchog de yis rang gis mkhyen te gsungs// mgron rnams thugs dang 'gal ba ci bsags pa//

bdag gis mthol bshags bzod par bzhes nas kyang*// zab mo'i chos kyis rgyud tshim bde bshegs bka'// ma 'da' rang gnas so sor bde bar dengs/ badzra muṃ/ ya hi gatstsha/ zhes pas rigs drug gi mgron thams cad gshags shing gtor ma bar pa gshegs par bya'o/ gsum pa lan chags bgegs rigs kyi gtor ma bsngo ba ni/ byin rlabs gong ltar las/ oṃ padma ta krid hya gṝ wa hūm̐ phaṭaḥ zhes pa'i gsang sngags brjod pa tsam gyis rang nyid dpal rdo rje sems dpa' gnas 'gyur te skad cig gis khro 345)rgyal rta mgrin dbang gyi rgyal po dmar nag dbyug to dang me dpung bsnams pa gar dgu'i nyams ldan khams gsum ma lus zil gyis gnon pa'i skur gyur/ hrīḥ rig pa'i rgyal po rta mchog he ru kaḥ byams chen rab sprul khro bo 'bum gyis bskor// stong nyid byings las bgegs rnams rdul du rlog /'jigs gzugs me ltar 'bar la phyag 'tshal bstod/ de nas bgegs dgug phyir rdor dril dang bcas pas lcags kyu'i phyag rgya bcas la/ na mo/ chos thams cad rang bzhin gyi rnam par dag cing cir yang ma grub la ji ltar bsam bzhin 'gags med du 'byung ba'i bden pa dang*/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes chen po thugs su chud cing sems can gyi don la dgongs pa skad cig kyang mi g.yel ba'i bden pa dang*/ dus gsum gyi bde bar gshegs pa rnam kyi dgongs pa skongs 346) shing sems can gyi mgon skyabs mdzad par zhal gyis bzhes pa'i srung ma khyad par can rnams kyi bden pa dang*/ bdag gi lhag pa'i bsam pas de bzhin gshegs pa'i gdung gsob cing sems can gyi don bya bar sems bskyed smon lam ting nge 'dzin gyi bden pa'i byin gyis brlabs kyis/ gdug cing sdang pa'i sems dang ldan pas gnod par byed pa'i bgegs kyi rigs su gyur pa thams cad gnas 'dir gtor ma'i mgron du skad cig thang cig yud tsam la 'di nyid du mchis par gyur cig

tri yaṃ dzaḥ sarba bhu ta badzra aṅku sha dzaḥ badzra pa sha hū/ badzra spho ṭa baṃ/ badzra ghaṇḍe hoḥ zhes bkug nas chu gtsang ma la bdag gi thugs ka'i 'od zer 'phros pas thim par bsam la bgegs rigs rnams kyi lce thog tu bzhag par dmigs nas gtor ma'i nyo skor thams cad du 'thor te/ hūm̐/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu// dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed// dam tshig 347)bsrung na dngos grub mchog /rdor rje bdud rtsi chu 'dis 'grub// ci te dam las 'gal gyur na// de ma thag tu snying 'gas shing*// rdo rje 'dzin rgyal khros nas ni// bdun rgyud rigs ni brlag par 'gyur/ oṃ badzra sa ma ya ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭaḥ bgegs rigs lan chags mgron rnams la// spos dang me tog mar me dri// zhal zas bza' btung 'dod yon tshogs// lan chags sbyang phyir phul ba yis// dgyes shing byams sems ldan gyur cig oṃ guṅka ra guṅka re swā hā/ pi tsi pi tsi swā hā/ guṃ guṃ swā hā/ sarba pū dza ghṛ ha ṇaṃ de bha lingta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ tshad med gtor ma rgyal chen 'di// bka' dang sngags dang phyag rgya dang*// bdag gi bsam pa'i smon lam mthus// rgyal ba'i mdzad pa lhun grub dang*// rdo rje 'chang dbang zhi dang 348)khro// kun gyi rang bzhin lta bu yis// dam nyams rdul du rlog byed cing*// bka' dang dam la gnas pa rnams/ 'dod yon ci 'dod thob byed pa'i// dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i gtor ma 'di// bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag gi// tshe rabs lan chags gang mchis la// sha khrag longs spyod dkor dang blud// gang 'dod dngos por stsal bgyis na// khyed rnams sha khon sems zhi nas// phan pa'i sems skye'i rgyu rkyen dang*// 'dod yon dpag med thob gyur cig /gang zhig mtshan mo rgyu ba yis// 'byung po rnams dang sha za dang*// srin po sha rjen za ba dang*// sems can rnams pa sna tshogs dang// ljon shing gel pa sogs gnas dag

/de dang de la gtor ma ni// bza' ba sha chang la phug bcas// 'bras chen 'bras bu mang po dang*// mchod pa 'di yi mgu byos la// gnod pa'i bsam sbyor zhi 349)ba dang*// bdag cag rnams la phan pa'i yid// de ring phyin chad bskyed par gyis// bka' dang bden tshig 'gal ba dang*// thub pa'i bstan dang 'khor gtses na// sdig par gyur pas khyod nyams nas// tshe 'phos dmyal khams brgyad 'gyur zhing*// byang chub sems ni ma skyes bar// sdug bsngal mnar med myong bar 'gyur// bdag cag ston pa'i rjes zhugs shing*// sems bskyed dam tshig nos pa la// khyed kyis bka' dang dam 'gal na// 'dir ni gnod sbyor byas gyur na// dam tshig nyams pa'i rnam smin dang*// ye shes lha yi chad pas gzir// khrag 'thur me dbal gnod sbyin gyis// khyod kyi snying khrag hubs 'thung ste/ mi bzad sdug bsngal myong bar 'gyur// de bas gnod sbyor slar bsdus la// phyin chad mi gnod dam bca' zhing*// gzhan gyis 350)gnod pa'ang khyed kyi bslung*// de ltar khyod kyis shes gyis la// de bzhin gshegs pa'i bka' ma bcag /dam pa'i chos kyi tshul ma dral// rnal 'byor bdag gi dam ma 'da'// dmyal ba chen po'i rgyu ma gsog /'chi ba'i srog la kun kyang 'jom// mtshon chas mi 'jigs gang yang med// rang gi lus la dpe long la// gzhan la gnod par ma byed cig oṃ/ chen po'am chung du gang yang rung*// lus la mngon par gnod gyur pa'i// nad de myur du phyungs mdzod la// gnod khyod rang gi gnas su dengs// deng 'dir bdag gis khyod mchod pas// mgu zhing rab tu tshim byos la// sngon gyi lan chags yod na yang*// mchod sbyin 'di yis 'khor bar gyis// sha khon bu lon nyams chags sogs// ma lus 'di yis dag par gyis/ 351) /bla med byang chub thob pa'i rgyur// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di gyur cig /gnas 'dir chags dang zhen byed na// bka' dang dam las 'das gyur pa'i// chad pas phog par khyod 'gyur gyi// rang gi gnas su da song zhig

sarba bhu ta gatstsha/ zhes khro bo'i ting 'dzin gyis bskrad do/ de nas chu gtor dang 'brel na de'i mjug chog rnams bya zhing*/ 'di nyid kyang pa yin na nyes byas bshags pa ni/ ma 'byor ba dang nyams pa dang*// gang yang bdag blo rmongs pa yis// legs byas 'di la nyes gyur gang*// de kun bzod par mdzad du gsol/ zhes dang yig brgya bzla/ sbyin pa rgya chen bgyis pa 'di yis mthus/ zhes sogs dang*/ sangs rgyas sku gsum brnyes pa sogs kyi bsngo smon rgyas bsdus skabs sbyar bya zhing*/ shis brjod ni/ ston mchog dam pa lha mi'i mchod 'os pa/ sangs rgyas phyag 'tshal deng 'dir 352)bde legs shog /sems can gang dag 'gro dang mi 'gro ba/ de dag thams cad deng 'dir bde legs shog /zhi ba chags bral lha mi'i mchod 'os pa// chos la phyag 'tshal deng 'dir bde legs shog// tshogs mchog dam pa lha mi'i mchod 'os pa// dge 'dun phyag 'tshal bde legs shog /'byung po gang dag 'dir ni lhag gyur tam// sa'am 'on te bar snang 'khod kyang rung*// skye dgu rnams la rtag tu byams byed cing// nyid dang mtshan du chos la spyod par shog sogs rgyas par byas pa'i mthar/ bdag bskyed rta mgrin yang 'od dmar po'i gong bur gyur nas 'ja' ltar yal bar dmigs la chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin ye stong mtha' bral chen po'i ngang nas rjes spyod la 'jug go/ cha gsum gyi gtor chog rgyas pa 'di ni gsang sngags snga 'gyur gyi lugs spyi dang*/ khyad par zhi khro bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa las ji ltar byung ba dang mthun pa las brjod bya cung zad nyung ngur bsdus te ltas chog 535) mar bkod pa 'di ni/ dbu mdzad o rgyan rdo rje sogs don gnyer dag gi ngor/ sna tshogs rang grol pas rang lo re gcig par chos dbyings 'od gsal rtser bris pa maṅga laṃ// dge'o// 354)
